Why Cybersecurity Is Essential in Pune in 2026 Pune has become one of the fastest-growing IT and technology centers in India. Thousands of startups, multinational companies, fintech organizations, healthcare providers, and manufacturing businesses rely heavily on digital infrastructure. Cyber dangers are becoming more likely as digital transformation picks up speed. According to Seqrite’s India Cyber Threat Report, Maharashtra recorded over 36 million malware detections in a single year, the highest of any state in the country. That’s nearly a quarter of all malicious activity nationwide concentrated right here. A few reasons cybersecurity has become non-negotiable for Pune businesses: Rising ransomware attacks on IT, manufacturing, and healthcare companies Phishing and social engineering scams exploiting employee mistakes Cloud misconfigurations across AWS, Azure, and GCP environments IoT and OT vulnerabilities in Pune’s growing smart factories Stricter compliance mandates under CERT-In guidelines and the DPDPA, 2023 Non-compliance with DPDPA can attract penalties running into hundreds of crores, which is why every organization—from a five-person startup to a global captive center—now needs a dependable cybersecurity service provider.
